He even managed to come up with a new Firespray.''"<br />"''Well, I wasn't going to say anything, but I heard that that same bunch showed up to help liberate Ord Mantell.''"<br />"''And Tholatin.'"<br />"''And Gyndine.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Talon Karrde]], [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]], and [[Booster Terrik]]|<ref name="TUF" />}}
The '''defense of Gyndine''' was fought late in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In the battle, [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], under [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], liberated the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] from [[Yuuzhan Vong]] control.<ref name="TUF" />
